fact: The driver of Car 3 stopped his car before Safety Car Line 1 when driving to the grid.
offence: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the International Sporting Code – Non-compliance with Race Director's Event Note (item 24, document 5).
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 3 stopped before reaching Safety Car Line 1 and therefore did not reach the grid (as defined in item 24 of the Race Director's Competition Notes) under its own power. However, as the end of the grid was extremely crowded when the car reached the grid, the Stewards determine the the driver acted appropriately and stopped the car in a safe spot as close as possible to the grid. Therefore no penalty is applied.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 3 Failure To Follow Race Directors Instructions Reaching The Grid
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
